name: Multi-resolution Hash Encoding with Simplex Structure
definition: A neural encoding method replacing the explicit grid-based structure of Instant-NGP with a simplex-based structure, using hash tables to store learnable feature vectors at simplex vertices across multiple resolution levels.
summary: Multi-resolution Hash Encoding with Simplex Structure replaces Instant-NGP's hypercube grids with simplex-based structures, using hash tables and barycentric interpolation to improve memory efficiency.
